plan.estimand: Within-subjects omnibus effect (F test, univariate), repeated measures at 3 time points
plan.hypothesis: H0: no within-time effect (equal means across 3 time points); H1: at least one time point differs
assumptions: Compound symmetry correlation structure (constant correlation 0.5 between all pairs of repeated measures)
Sphericity assumption satisfied (epsilon = 1.0), univariate F test valid
scientific_notes: Effect size conversion: partial eta-squared = 0.08 → f = sqrt(0.08/(1−0.08)) = sqrt(0.0870) ≈ 0.295

G*Power method for repeated measures univariate ANOVA: computes numerator df = 2 (k−1, where k=3 time points), scales effect accounting for compound symmetry correlation; non-centrality parameter λ = f × sqrt(n × effective multiplier)
Compound symmetry with r=0.5 and k=3 reduces effective sample size relative to uncorrelated observations
Univariate F test with sphericity epsilon=1 is equivalent to multivariate approach for this one-group design
